items.source: Serves as base interface for BeanWrapper.
items.translation: 作为BeanWrapper的基础接口。

items.source: Specify a ConversionService to use for converting property values, as an alternative to JavaBeans PropertyEditors.
items.translation: 指定一个用于转换属性值的 `ConversionService`，作为 JavaBeans PropertyEditors 的替代方案。

items.source: Return the associated ConversionService, if any.
items.translation: 返回关联的 ConversionService（如果有）。

items.source: Return whether "auto-growing" of nested paths has been activated.
items.translation: 返回嵌套路径的“自动增长”是否已激活。

items.source:
Return whether to extract the old property value when applying a
property editor to a new value for a property.
items.translation: 返回在将属性编辑器应用于属性的新值时是否提取旧属性值。

items.source:
Set whether to extract the old property value when applying a
property editor to a new value for a property.
items.translation: 设置是否在将属性编辑器应用于属性的新值时提取旧属性值。

items.source: If true, a null path location will be populated with a default object value and traversed instead of resulting in a NullValueInNestedPathException.
items.translation: 如果为 `true`，则会将 `null` 路径位置填充为默认对象值并进行遍历，而不是导致出现 NullValueInNestedPathException。

items.source: Default is false on a plain PropertyAccessor instance.
items.translation: 默认情况下，在普通的 PropertyAccessor 实例上为false。

items.source: Set whether this instance should attempt to "auto-grow" a nested path that contains a null value.
items.translation: 设置此实例是否应尝试“自动增长”包含 `null` 值的嵌套路径。
